title: IAM users enumeration
description: Enumerates IAM users in the account; IAM is global and always served from us-east-1, so the query takes no parameters.
notes: IAM is global: region = 'us-east-1' is endpoint routing, never a filter, and applies to every IAM query. The template is the cheap identifier-only path via Cloud Control, requiring iam:ListUsers; the native variation requires only iam:ListUsers and returns ARN, user id, creation date, password_last_used and path in one call. password_last_used is the string null for users who have never signed in with a console password. Sibling list-only resources with the same shape cover roles (awscc.iam.roles_list_only) and groups (awscc.iam.groups_list_only).
author: Jeffrey Aven
